dedupe_keys.name: intersection vehicular traffic flow scheduling datasets

description: Babangida Zachariah and colleagues publish a CSV for intersection vehicle-flow scheduling. Zenodo serves the file under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The public description identifies waiting time, queue length and signal phase duration as the variables, intended for training computational scheduling methods at isolated intersections or roundabouts. These features can form a test case for traffic-signal optimisation or be compared with queue outputs from an intersection simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this training file. A limitation is that the landing page does not identify a measured location, time interval, vehicle classes, sample count or signal-control policy. Its provenance may be generated, not field-observed, so results should not be treated as a calibrated urban network. The CSV was not downloaded, and distributions, units and any claimed traffic-delay improvement were not checked.
